title: Experimental Data on Concrete Shield Transmission of Quasi-monoenergetic Neutrons Generated by 43- and 68-MeV Protons via the 7Li(p,n) Reaction
notes: Source spectra are Tables 3 and 4; the monoenergetic peak integral is normalized to unity.
Absolute peak flux for each experimental setup is supplied separately in jaeri_tiara_experiment_setup.csv.
BC501A transmitted spectra are digitized directly from numerical Tables 10-15, not from plotted curves.
Transmission flux units are n cm^-2 lethargy^-1 uC^-1.
Missing off-axis rows in the published tables are omitted rather than interpolated.
Dose-equivalent measured values are Table 24; estimated-from-spectrum values are Table 25.
The 68-MeV Table 25 entries at 25 cm and 200 cm are explicitly absent in the source and remain NaN.
